$comment: K14-6 (K1.4 design 01 §11; design 02 D01-CHK-09). Generated from design 01 §11 at build and maintained here. architecture/legacy-mapping.test.ts lists the declared set at runtime and fails on a missing or extra file or an owner that does not exist.

dispositions.P: Retained, plus a bridge test through the SDK entry for its host-observable property (bridge).

tests/conformance/execution/cancellation.property: Kernel claim now owned by K1.3's `packages/kernel/tests/cancellation.test.ts` and `losing-outcomes.test.ts`. Bridge: B-CANCEL. File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/execution/controlled-i.property: `interleave` is legacy wait vocabulary with no Kernel home; the Kernel never sees it. Kept property: the Driver declares no Kernel wait for native-only dependencies (B-QUIESCE-CELLS (design 02 D01-CHK-02 replaced design 01 §3's table by the predicate; B-MAP's cases are its cells)). The Driver commits a Kernel wait only on a validated observation, under real native settlements (B-OBSERVE-SCHEDULES, design 03 R1-01). File kept as native regression (DX-6).

tests/conformance/execution/controller-b.property: The controller port is refused at the Kernel (DX-12); the Driver boundary replaces it. Kept property: the Kernel observes no Promise and no controller type (B-DELIVER, K14-2 guards). File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/execution/controller-r.property: Kept property: slow native work creates no Kernel-visible wait; the exchange stays RUNNING and resumes exactly once (B-RES). File kept as native regression (DX-6).

tests/conformance/execution/definition-k.property: The closed `DefinitionKind` union is refused at the Kernel (DX-12); the Activation pins a definition revision instead. Kept property: the Driver resolves exactly the pinned revision (B-PIN). File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/execution/harness-many.property: Bridge: one application, one Driver, many Kernel Executions with separate native lineages (B-MANY).

tests/conformance/execution/interleaving.property: Native cost discipline; no Kernel claim.

tests/conformance/execution/lifecycle.te.property: The Kernel lifecycle is owned by `packages/kernel/tests/outcome-acceptance.test.ts` and `terminal.test.ts`. Kept property: the bridge maps native terminal states to Outcomes and never reopens a terminal Execution (B-TERM). File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/execution/multi-depend.property: `await_dependencies` is legacy wait vocabulary. Kept property: B-QUIESCE-CELLS (design 02 D01-CHK-02 replaced design 01 §3's table by the predicate; B-MAP's cases are its cells). The Driver commits a Kernel wait only on a validated observation, under real native settlements (B-OBSERVE-SCHEDULES, design 03 R1-01). File kept as native regression (DX-6).

tests/conformance/execution/ownership.te.property: Host-supplied `ownerExecutionId` is refused by name at the SDK (inventory S-OWNER); native ownership inside a lineage is unchanged. File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/execution/response-vs-.property: Bridge: a respond_and_wait reply is an Emission plus await, never complete (B-WAKE; inventory G-CHAT).

tests/conformance/execution/scheduler-ex.property: One current Activation per Execution is owned by `packages/kernel/tests/dispatch.test.ts`, `submission-authority.test.ts` and `takeover.test.ts`. Kept property: a stalled native lineage does not block another Execution (B-STALL, K14-1). File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/execution/terminal-res.property: Bridge: `complete` carries the native terminal result as canonical bytes; an unrepresentable value fails by name (B-TERM, B-VALUE-RESULT-70K).

tests/conformance/execution/wait-wake-re.property: Kernel waits are owned by `packages/kernel/tests/waits-*.test.ts`. Kept property: an input reply wakes the declared Kernel wait and reaches native exactly once (B-WAKE). File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/interaction/event-deli.property: Receipts are the Kernel's, owned by `packages/kernel/tests/creation.test.ts`, `ingress.test.ts` and `receipts.test.ts`. Kept property: an exact input retry replays and native receives one Event (B-INPUT), including a keyed retry whose omitted destination the Kernel already resolved, after the pause changed or E ended (B-INPUT-RETRY, design 03 R1-02). File kept as native regression.

tests/conformance/interaction/mechanical.property: Bridge: confirmation decisions travel as Kernel input and reach native exactly once; an exact retry replays (B-CONFIRM).

tests/conformance/interaction/user-input.property: Typed user input needs a custom controller, which the SDK does not host; native regression only. The deprecated `harness.submitUserInput` refuses by name (inventory S-HARNESS-W).
